name: 盒装抽取双面擦脸巾款

category.leaf: 盒装抽取式一次性双面擦脸巾

description: 抽取式单片擦脸巾，双面质地、干湿两用，替代反复使用的旧毛巾

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with powder-blue infographic fields #DCEAF6 and pale terry-texture panels #F2F6FA
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool high-key studio light from the front-left with a soft fill card, gentle skimming light on texture close-ups, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone shelf #E7E2DC and soft white terry-texture field #F2F6FA
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only, short labels kept inside rounded lozenge pills
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #14406B inside circular badges, numbered circles for lists
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and constant carton scale across the set; a single sheet always lifted from the dispensing slot with one soft drape; flat accent band #14406B at the carton base
noDrift: no filled-in seals, badges, charts or numerals
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean pharmacy-blue skincare commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, powder-blue infographic field #DCEAF6, deep blue accent #14406B and pale stone surface #E7E2DC; cool high-key studio lighting from the front-left with a soft fill card and soft contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif family only; thin single-weight line icons in deep blue #14406B inside circular badges; rounded lozenge label pills and flat panel cards; stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and constant carton scale; every seal, chart and label left as a blank placeholder shape; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented figures.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表用开盖抽片的一眼动作赢得点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, carton front square to camera, lid flipped open
shots.lighting: bright high-key front-left key with soft fill card, soft contact shadow under the base
shots.promptTemplate: White-background packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The carton faces the camera square-on at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle, lid flipped open, one sheet lifting out of the dispensing slot with a soft drape over the front edge. Bright high-key studio light from the front-left with a soft fill card on the shadow side and one soft contact shadow under the carton base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, flat accent band at the carton base in #14406B. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace and no copy area. Negative: no wordmark or brand lettering, no certification seals or badge artwork, no count or size numerals, no inner-lid slogan, no hands, no props, no watermark, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no duplicated carton.

shots.intent: 用编号清单放大旧毛巾反复使用的脏污与残留痛点
shots.camera: dead-on straight-on graphic elevation of the information plane
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no directional shadow
shots.background: powder-blue field #DCEAF6 with white #FFFFFF lozenge rows
shots.props: three thin-line circular icon badges, numbered circles, one small carton thumbnail at the base
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top headline band
shots.textZone: top headline band plus one label pill inside each of the three lozenge rows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point infographic listing numbered reasons to switch away from a re-used towel, with {product} shown small at the base of the panel. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Dead-on straight-on graphic elevation of the layout plane: three rounded white #FFFFFF lozenge rows stacked on a powder-blue field #DCEAF6, every row opening with a thin single-weight line icon in #14406B inside a circular badge and a filled numbered circle. Headline placeholder reads 「{selling_point_1}」 and the three row labels read 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 on clean empty lines. Even flat high-key lighting with no directional shadow. The icon column and carton together occupy 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the top headline band. Negative: no percentages or study statistics, no contamination artwork touching the product, no dense body text, no identifiable competing product, no watermark, no garbled lettering.

shots.intent: 用双栏勾叉表把差异结构化成一眼可读的选择理由
shots.camera: flat lay from a directly overhead 90-degree angle onto the comparison card
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, soft edge shadow under the card
shots.background: white #FFFFFF card on a pale terry-texture field #F2F6FA
shots.props: two anonymous column pictograms at the card head, thin divider rules
shots.whitespace: clean even margins on both card edges
shots.textZone: five left-hand row labels plus one highlighted own-product column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison infographic, flat lay shot from a directly overhead 90-degree angle of a white #FFFFFF card lying on a pale terry-texture field #F2F6FA. {product} appears only as two small anonymous pictograms at the head of the columns, one standing on a highlighted #14406B column and one on an unbranded neutral column. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two-column layout with five stacked rows, thin divider rules and empty tick and cross glyph slots; the row labels read 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_4}」 and the header line reads 「{selling_point_2}」. Even high-key flat lighting with a soft edge shadow under the card. The card fills 50-60% of the frame with clean margins on both sides. Negative: no real competing brand, no invented attribute claims, no dense body copy, no readable trademark, no warped straight lines, no watermark, no garbled text.

shots.intent: 用双面质地微距解释结构与使用方式，撑起卖点
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a low side profile along the curving sheet, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: cool skimming light sweeping in from the left, falloff into shadow on the right
shots.props: two blank pill labels with leader lines, two empty circular seal frames
shots.whitespace: negative space held on the upper left for copy
shots.textZone: left-side label column with two leader-line pills and two blank seal frames top right
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of one sheet drawn from {product}, tight zoom on the curving edge where the two weave faces meet, photographed from a low side profile with a shallow depth of field. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Cool skimming light sweeping in from the left to reveal the fine waffle weave, falling into soft shadow on the right. Soft off-white field #FBFAF8. Two blank rounded pill labels on thin leader lines read 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」, and two empty circular seal frames sit at the top right with nothing drawn inside. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with negative space held on the upper left. Negative: no fibre or composition percentages, no certification or approval marks, no blurry subject, no plastic-looking texture, no hands, no watermark, no extra props.

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入洁面后擦干的真实日常
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level portrait framing, sheet held at cheek height
shots.lighting: soft cool window daylight from the left at 5600K with gentle fill, no harsh speculars
shots.background: powder-blue field #DCEAF6 grading into pure white #FFFFFF behind the figure
shots.props: four blank rounded lozenge label rows on the left
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the left copy column
shots.textZone: four stacked lozenge rows on the left carrying usage line labels
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle usage scene: a generic adult with no resemblance to any real person, hair and shoulders cropped at the frame edge and face turned slightly away, pressing one sheet drawn from {product} gently against the cheek in a patting motion, photographed straight-on at eye level. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft cool window daylight from the left at 5600K with a gentle fill and no harsh speculars. Powder-blue field #DCEAF6 grading into pure white #FFFFFF behind the figure; four blank rounded lozenge rows stacked on the left read 「{callout_7}」 with the section title 「{selling_point_3}」. The figure and product occupy 40-50% of the frame with generous negative space down the left copy column. Negative: no recognizable celebrity likeness, no deformed fingers or extra digits, no hands covering the sheet, no over-smoothed plastic skin, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏前后状态证明换巾后的肌肤差异
shots.camera: matched dead-on straight-on close-up panels, identical crop and camera height on both halves
shots.lighting: left half flat drying light, right half soft cool light, identical falloff position
shots.background: clean pale blue-white field #EDF3F8 with bottom bars in #9AA6B2 and #14406B
shots.props: one loose sheet resting at the lower edge of the right panel only
shots.whitespace: clear border space around both panels
shots.textZone: two bottom caption bars plus one headline strip above the panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce before-and-after comparison, two matched panels with identical framing, crop and camera height, dead-on straight-on close-ups of cheek and jaw skin only with no full face and no identity. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel under flat drying light showing a dull uneven surface; right panel in soft cool light showing a calmer smoother surface, with one loose sheet from {product} resting at its lower edge only. Clean pale blue-white field #EDF3F8, bottom caption bars in #9AA6B2 and #14406B reading 「{callout_8}」 and 「{callout_9}」, headline strip reading 「{selling_point_4}」. Each panel subject fills 50-60% of its half with clear border space around both panels. Negative: no fabricated results, no percentage or duration numerals, no study or trial wording, no identical face reused across panels, no heavy skin smoothing, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用三张留白数据卡承接成效证明而不编造任何数值
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the three-card row
shots.lighting: even high-key cool light from the upper left, soft shadows under each card
shots.background: white #FFFFFF cards on a pale terry-texture field #F2F6FA
shots.props: three open progress rings with blank centres, empty label lines under each ring
shots.whitespace: clear space held above the card row for the headline
shots.textZone: one headline band plus two empty label lines inside each card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce proof infographic shot from a high 45-degree angle looking down at three white #FFFFFF rounded lozenge cards lying on a pale terry-texture field #F2F6FA, with {product} sitting small at the near edge of the composition. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each card carries one large open progress ring drawn in #14406B with a blank centre and no readout, above two empty label lines; the headline placeholder reads 「{selling_point_5}」. Even high-key cool light from the upper left with soft shadows under each card. The card row occupies 50-60% of the frame with clear space held above for the headline. Negative: no numbers or percentages inside the rings, no invented study results, no gauges with readings, no dense body copy, no watermark, no garbled lettering.

shots.intent: 让买家在一屏内按色系挑到自己的那一盒
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward along a diagonal ascending row of four cartons
shots.lighting: bright even cool studio light from the front-left with soft fill and soft contact shadows
shots.props: four hex-pinned accent bands, one blank pill above each band, one sheet lifted from the nearest carton
shots.whitespace: clean empty space above and below the diagonal row
shots.textZone: one blank pill per carton plus a closing line at the base
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward along a diagonal ascending row of four cartons of {product}, every carton identical in shape and scale with its front face square to the camera and one sheet lifted from the nearest carton. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each carton carries a single flat accent band in its own hex-pinned variant colour: #14A7A0, #6B3FA0, #2E7D46 and #14406B; one blank rounded pill floats above each band reading 「{callout_1}」 and a closing line at the base reads 「{selling_point_6}」. Bright even cool studio light from the front-left with a soft fill card and soft contact shadows under each carton. Powder-blue field #CFE3F3. The row occupies 70-80% of the frame overall with clean empty space above and below. Negative: no colour drift between cartons, no medical or skin-condition wording, no certification seals, no mixed lighting between cartons, no duplicated carton details, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以空白背书栏收口降低决策风险而不搬任何真实标识
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle from a low shelf-level viewpoint, carton on the left, panel on the right
shots.lighting: soft cool daylight from the left at 5500K, soft contact shadow under the carton
shots.background: matte pale stone shelf #E7E2DC with a gently blurred bathroom backdrop
shots.props: tall rounded panel with six empty rectangular slots and one blank header lozenge in #14406B
shots.whitespace: clear space held across the top of the frame
shots.textZone: blank header lozenge on the side panel plus six empty logo slots
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen, slight 3/4 angle from a low shelf-level viewpoint: {product} standing on a matte pale stone shelf #E7E2DC with its lid raised and one sheet resting over the front edge, beside a tall rounded white #FFFFFF panel holding a grid of six empty rectangular slots and one blank header lozenge in #14406B. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft cool daylight from the left at 5500K over a gently blurred bathroom backdrop, with a soft contact shadow grounding the carton. The carton and panel together occupy 50-60% of the frame with clear space held across the top. Negative: no magazine or press names, no publication logos, no award or certification seals, no readable lettering in the empty slots, no star ratings, no floating product without a contact shadow, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底开盒、单片从取用口抽出并垂搭前缘；002 新旧两版盒型并列，右侧一枚圆形磁扣图标；003 左右两栏面部局部前后状态对照，底部两条色带标签；004 三张白卡各配一个圆环图与两行说明；005 与 006 为同一套编号胶囊清单（图标圆徽＋编号圆＋两行文字），合并为一镜；007 巾片弯曲微距，左侧两枚胶囊引线标签，右上两枚印章图形；008 双栏表，本品行高亮、对照列勾叉共五行；009 人物持巾按脸，左侧四行胶囊使用说明；010 四盒斜向阶梯并列，各配一条色带与肤质标签；011 台面盒体居左，右侧对话气泡状面板排满媒体标识墙。品类判定依据：全套主体为盒装抽取式单片擦脸巾，使用动作全部落在洁面后擦干、配合卸妆与温和擦拭，属面部清洁护理耗材，故归「护肤个护／面部护理」；未选「美妆彩妆／美妆工具」因全套主张为清洁护理与肌肤状态而非着色彩妆；未选「家居日用／纸品清洁」因场景与人群全为面部肌肤；与源类目路径的宽泛美妆个护挂法不冲突。已剥离内容：原品牌字与系列名、店铺与社交账号等原平台店铺字样、全部认证与认可类印章图形（改为空白印章框）、圆环与标题内的全部百分比与试验人数说明（改为无读数空环与空参数行）、新旧包装与清单上的原文案原句（改为占位胶囊与空标签线）、模特面容身份（改为无身份的 generic adult 与侧脸裁切）、数量与尺码徽章数字（改为空徽章框）。
